from: June book, night 13 (The Lord Sees the Heart)
p1: The Lord sent Samuel to Bethlehem, to a man named Jesse. The Lord said, “I have chosen a king from his sons.”
Jesse’s son Eliab came. He was tall and fine-looking. Samuel said, “This must be the one!”
But the Lord said, “Do not look at how tall he is. People look on the outside, but the Lord looks on the heart.”
p2: Seven sons came, but the Lord had not chosen them. The youngest, David, was out caring for the sheep. When David came, the Lord said, “This is he.” Samuel poured oil on David’s head to show he was chosen.
Heavenly Father sees your heart too. He sees every kind thing you do. Tonight, tell Him one kind thing you did.
old: Heavenly Father told Samuel, “Go to Jesse’s house. I’ve chosen one of his sons to be the next king.” Samuel went. Jesse had EIGHT sons!
Jesse’s oldest son came first. He was tall and handsome! Samuel thought, “This must be the one!” But God said, “No. People look at the outside, but I look at the HEART.”
Seven sons came. They were all strong and impressive. But God said no to each one! Samuel asked, “Are these all your sons?” Jesse said, “Well, there’s David. He’s the youngest, watching the sheep.”
They brought David in. He was just a young shepherd boy! But God said, “This is the one!” Samuel anointed David. God chose David not for how he looked, but for his good heart!
